title: Minimum Number of Changes to Make Binary String Beautiful
sourceKind: secondary mirror (leetcode.doocs.org/en/lc/2914); official page not retrievable
summary: A binary string is beautiful if it splits into even-length substrings that are all 1s or all 0s; return the fewest changes needed.
officialConstraints: 2 <= s.length <= 10^5; s.length is even; s[i] is '0' or '1' (exponent read from the mirror).
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps s at 50 characters. Difficulty Medium is from a search snippet.
